name: a5-explain-contradiction-check
notes: A5 (2.3 I2): every declared contradiction check is evaluated and reported with its status; the exit-to-reparent edge names CHILD_REPARENTED_BEFORE_EXIT and its ABSENT status.

The phrase 'none recorded' must not appear in the explanation when declared checks exist - the audited engine printed it in the alternatives filler while the check evaluation itself was already honest (8.2 I2).
No OOM_EVENT may appear: v1 carries no kernel record for a normal process exit.

Re-audit 2026-10-28 (principal, causal-semantics.md §5.2 clarified): a failure is never its own candidate, and an escalation-only path is the anchor's own episode (known chain), not a contributing factor. Suspected-kill/write-failure alternatives explain exit failures only, never a condition anchor.

missing_evidence_includes: exit status and signal lineage are not captured in v1 bundles
